bullets: Free mode users who hit a pacing limit no longer see a separate slowed-session notice, and SDK callers can no longer register a listener to show their own renewal prompts.
When the Freebuff app installs a background update, the launcher can restart without dropping your paid session back to the model picker.
Freebuff now waits until you close your session before installing an automatic update, so downloads never interrupt a running assistant.
Sponsored tasks now run directly in your current folder instead of creating a separate branch and pull request, with a single new command, /ads:undo, to revert them.
A new History button (labeled 'H · History') lets you browse past conversations between chats or when viewing an old transcript.
The Freebuff CLI now resumes your unused paid hour if the terminal crashes or closes unexpectedly instead of charging you again for a new session.
Solar Pro 4 is back in the free model picker and stays on Pro 4 when chosen, instead of automatically switching to Solar Mini 4.
Your first-tab discount is now read from the same purchase account that is billed for the session, so CLI pricing is shown correctly.
When the CLI unpacks its built-in file-search tool at startup, it writes to a temp folder first and only moves it into place once fully written and runnable.
A DeepSeek content safety refusal is now recognized by the shared error list and directs you to switch models rather than retry the same blocked request.
Sponsored task runs now get their one-hour compute budget when the task actually starts, instead of counting down from when the run was accepted.
